title: our little timeline
subtitle: let your touch clear the haze, guide your light through our days...

entries.text:
Somewhere the nightingale sung a new song, and I joined Petrichor. 
It was that lipstick. And it was those smiles.
 "And maybe, just maybe, I might crawl for her for miles."

finalMessage.text1: Oh, there's one more thing i should have said sooner, maybe on the first page... or the first day–
